chunks: He has been allowed time by Allāh. He is falling into error along with negligent persons and goes early in the morning with sinners, without any road to lead or any way, without any road to lead or any Imām to guide.

key_terms.يَغْدُو: he goes forth early in the morning

ai.seo_question: What characterizes the state of the misguided according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In the context of Nahj al-Balagha’s classification of human types, this description characterizes the 'misguided' as those who, despite divine respite, drift aimlessly among the heedless and sinners without a definitive path or guiding Imam. This state reflects a spiritual void where the lack of a clear 'Imam Qa’id' (guiding leader) underscores the Shia emphasis on authoritative guidance to prevent such disorientation. The imagery highlights the consequence of neglecting divine signs, leading to a life devoid of purposeful direction.

en.sayed-ali-raza: He has been allowed time by Allāh. He is falling into error along with negligent persons and goes early in the morning with sinners, without any road to lead or any Imām to guide.
